chapter: Riverboat to New Orleans and Horace Henderson
title: One-nighters out of Cleveland and being stranded in Buffalo when Horace vanishes
summary: The band played one-nighters through Pennsylvania and Ohio, was booked for a week at a Buffalo club that did not exist, and Horace disappeared, leaving the players stuck.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: So what happens is there's about four of us now in that band, and of course Luke was not in the band. He was out of Kentucky. So then we started playing these one nighters on percentage, and sometimes you'd have a few people and sometimes you didn't, you know, and that's the way it was. And we were booked out of Cleveland, you know. So we'd play different towns, like through Pennsylvania and little

towns, Oil City and Scranton and Wilkes Barre and things like that, and in Ohio, you know, and then somebody booked us on a date, the agent booked us on a date to go to Celeron Park (PHONETIC). I think that's in Jamestown. And between Buffalo and Cleveland. So we were on a one nighter there, then into Buffalo for a week at the Rainbow Gardens. Well, we got -- I don't know why this happened, I don't know how it happened, but we got there. There wasn't any Rainbow Gardens. So now here we are, stuck in Buffalo. So we stayed around there a couple of days, then Horace is gone, you know. Horace disappears. Now we don't know where Horace is. So here's the band. So a guy named Tom Amagon, an Italian guy, he had a club called the Zilla (PHONETIC). It was a dance hall, you know.
